cards.text: Saul was Israel's king before David (1 Samuel 11:15), and now David's on the throne. During David's reign, a famine hits for three years in a row, and THREE years, friend, that's not a rough patch anymore, that's a lifestyle. So David seeks the face of the LORD.

cards.question: David asks the LORD about the three-year famine. What does the LORD say it's because of?

answers.text: Blood Saul shed killing the Gibeonites
Idols the people set up in the land

cards.text: So David calls in the Gibeonites, who aren't Israelites but what's left of the Amorites. Israel had taken an oath concerning them.

cards.question: Saul kept the oath Israel had taken concerning the Gibeonites.

cards.text: In his zeal for Israel and Judah, Saul had sought to kill them.

cards.question: David calls in the Gibeonites, the people Saul sought to kill. What does David ask them?

answers.text: How he can make amends to them

cards.text: He wants them to be able to bless the inheritance of the LORD. The Gibeonites say they need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, and David shouldn't put anyone in Israel to death for them.

cards.question: The Gibeonites turn down silver and gold from Saul's house. What does David reply?

answers.text: Whatever you ask I will do for you
Then I have nothing else to offer you
Then I will ask the LORD again

cards.question: The Gibeonites talk about the man who consumed them and plotted to wipe them out of Israel. What do they ask David to hand over?

answers.text: Half of the land Saul held

cards.text: David promised, "Whatever you ask…" before he even heard the ask. Now they say they want to hang the seven before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul.

cards.question: David agrees to give the Gibeonites the seven they asked for.

cards.text: But one of Saul's grandsons is spared: Mephibosheth, the son of Saul's son Jonathan.

cards.question: Why does David spare Mephibosheth son of Jonathan?

answers.text: Because of his oath with Jonathan
Because the Gibeonites left him out
Because Mephibosheth was still a child

cards.text: Careful now, friend, because there's ANOTHER Mephibosheth in this story, a son Rizpah daughter of Aiah bore to Saul himself. Two Mephibosheths, like two guys named Mike on the same work team.

cards.question: David takes Armoni and Mephibosheth, Rizpah's two sons. He also takes the sons of Saul's daughter ___.

cards.text: Merab bore them to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite, not the Barzillai of Gilead.

cards.question: Two sons from Rizpah plus ___ sons from Merab make the seven the Gibeonites asked for.

cards.text: This one's heavy, friend. David delivers the seven into the hands of the Gibeonites.

cards.question: When are the seven sons of Saul's house put to death?

answers.text: At the beginning of the barley harvest
At the end of the wheat harvest

cards.text: They hang them on the hill before the LORD, and all seven fall together. Then Rizpah, the mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth, spreads sackcloth out for herself on a rock.

cards.question: Rizpah keeps watch over the bodies of the seven who were hanged. What does she keep away from them, day and night?

answers.text: Birds by day and beasts by night
Thieves by day and strangers by night
Soldiers by day and mourners by night

cards.question: Rizpah keeps her watch until the rain from heaven pours down on the bodies.

cards.text: Word of what Saul's concubine Rizpah has done reaches David.

cards.question: When David hears what Rizpah has done, whose bones does he go and take?

cards.text: He takes them from the men of Jabesh-gilead. Those men had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hung the bodies after striking Saul down at Gilboa.

cards.question: The bones of the seven who were hanged are left where they are.

cards.text: They bury the bones of Saul and Jonathan in Zela, in the land of Benjamin.

cards.question: Saul and Jonathan are buried in Zela, in the tomb of Saul's father ___.
They do everything King David commanded. What happens after that?

answers.text: God answers their prayers for the land
The Gibeonites move away from Israel
Saul's family turns against King David
